fusions.name: Sting Shower
fusions.desc: Looses 3 barbed arrows at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 poison damage, with a 25% chance per hit to leave the target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Darting Drone
fusions.desc: Fires an arrow that deals 6 damage to the first enemy it meets, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage. Holds 5 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Unflagging Arm
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Swarm Count
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (163% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
